snippet.title: ZOO PROTOCOL - OFFICIAL EARLY ACCESS TRAILER
snippet.description:
ZOO PROTOCOL is a co-op sci-fi horror game for up to 5 players set inside an isolated waste-processing complex on a distant planet.

Contain anomalous creatures, maintain failing facility systems, process waste and fulfill production quotas while the entire complex slowly spirals out of control.

Every problem creates another one — and routine maintenance quickly turns into a fight for survival.

Wishlist on Steam! Link in comments and profile.
